detail.longDescription: Google does not provide official docker image for developers or AI agents to run dataproc cluster locally. so everybody need to spin up for even dev/CI testing,etc.. now you or your AI agent can: docker run --rm agentcloud/dataproc:3.0.0-debian13 self-test saves time and cost. it basically packages the same component version and make the hadoop and spark to developer. Here are docker images for other dataproc versions: https://hub.docker.com/r/agentcloud/dataproc/tags here is full blog for more use-cases: https://local.cloud/blog/run-dataproc-locally-docker/
